abilities.desc_zh: 远程射击注入数据木马，使敌人无法使用特殊技 3 秒，并扰乱其能量条。
abilities.desc_en: Ranged shots inject trojan code, locking opponent Special Attacks for 3s and corrupting their power meter.

abilities.desc_zh: 战斗开始时获得 4 个护盾增益，每个护盾增益将一次攻击造成的伤害上限限制为对手攻击力的 75%。被近战攻击命中或者防御攻击时消耗一个护盾。护盾全消耗完之后触发系统反噬：对敌人施加震击减益，造成攻击力 50% 的伤害，持续 4 秒，并进入 10 秒充能状态，倒计时结束后重新获得 4 个护盾。
abilities.desc_en: Starts the fight with 4 Shield Buffs, each capping incoming damage to 75% of opponent Attack. Consumes 1 Shield upon being hit by or blocking an attack. When all Shields are depleted, triggers a system backlash inflicting Shock (50% Attack over 4s), then enters a 10s cooldown before refreshing 4 Shields.

abilities.desc_zh: 当敌方蓄满任意一整格能量时，有 [40% - 75%] 概率退回其刚获取的该格能量，并对其施加持续 [3 - 5] 秒的能量锁定减益，阻止其获得能量和释放特殊技。
abilities.desc_en: When the opponent fills any full bar of Power, has a [40% - 75%] chance to deplete that entire filled bar and inflict Power Lock for [3s - 5s], preventing Power Gain and Special Attacks.

abilities.desc_zh: 最后一击命中 100% 概率施加能量锁定减益，阻止对方获得能量和释放特殊技，持续 3.5 秒；50% 概率施加眩晕减益，持续 1.5 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Last hit: 100% chance to inflict Power Lock for 3.5s, preventing Power Gain and Special Attacks; 50% chance to inflict Stun for 1.5s.

abilities.desc_zh: 最后一击命中 100% 概率触发能量窃取，窃取对手当前能量值的 20% 转化为自身能量；并施加持续 5 秒的能量流失减益，在持续时间内扣除对方 1 格能量的 60%。
abilities.desc_en: Last hit: 100% chance to trigger Power Steal, stealing 20% of opponent current Power; and inflicts Power Leak for 5s, draining 60% of 1 bar of Power over the duration.

abilities.desc_zh: 最后一击 100% 概率即时扣除对方全部现有能量；技能结束后 100% 概率施加能量锁定减益，持续 6 秒，并施加 25% 的攻击减益，持续 6 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Last hit: 100% chance to completely drain all opponent Power; inflicts Power Lock for 6s and a 25% Attack Debuff for 6s after the Special ends.

abilities.desc_zh: 与声波、震荡波同队时，能量获取率提升 {{var_1}}。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_1}} Power Rate when teamed with Soundwave or Shockwave.

abilities.desc_zh: 与红蜘蛛同队时，获得 +{{var_2}} 破甲。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_2}} Armor Piercing when paired with Starscream.

abilities.desc_zh: 团队所有低星级队员获得 +{{var_3}} 暴击率。
abilities.desc_en: All lower tier teammates gain +{{var_3}} Critical Rating.
